mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN r.poet_id = #{poetId} THEN r.related_id ELSE r.poet_id END AS relatedId, p2.name AS relatedName, p2.title AS relatedTitle, p2.dynasty AS relatedDynasty, r.rel_type AS relType, r.note AS note FROM poet_relation r JOIN poet p2 ON p2.id = (CASE WHEN r.poet_id = #{poetId} THEN r.related_id ELSE r.poet_id END) WHERE r.poet_id = #{poetId} OR r.related_id = #{poetId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
